objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package. This is design and inventory tooling only: no deletion, no local execution, no paid services. Define a structured audit schema, a discovery procedure, a read-only PowerShell inventory script that can later be run manually on Windows, and an Astra review packet. Update project memory/provenance. The audit script must never delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, or alter files.
constraints: No AI video inference on local PC
No cleanup deletion or uninstall actions
PowerShell script must be read-only and output an inventory report only
acceptance_criteria: The GitHub Cloud Worker Task completes with the deterministic TASK-0001 preflight step passing.
No deprecated CANDIDATE_FOR_AUDIT appears in script/schema/review packet.
Exact normalized provenance_match semantics are implemented.
External unprovenanced candidate files are UNVERIFIED_DO_NOT_REMOVE.
All active project files including nested worker_result_*.json are KEEP_ACTIVE.
Missing/file-valued/unreadable roots fail; enumeration errors are not suppressed.
Duplicate roots emit unique absolute paths only.
OutputPath is true FileMode.CreateNew and preserves existing-file hashes.
Zero/one/many candidate roots serialize as arrays.
Schema requires all item fields and enums recommendation/evidence_source with date-time formats.
CURRENT_STATE records Google Drive and configured Gemini repository secret; NEXT_ACTIONS removes completed manual setup.
Review packet is pending with truthful CI evidence placeholders.
When AgentOwnedCandidateRoots includes ActiveProjectRoot, hidden/dot files are enumerated; .gitignore appears exactly once and is KEEP_ACTIVE.
.github/workflows/manual_worker_smoke.yml appears exactly once and is KEEP_ACTIVE.
nested worker_result_TASK-*.json anywhere under ActiveProjectRoot appears exactly once and is KEEP_ACTIVE.
Cloud Worker Task deterministic preflight completes successfully.
retry_reason: Deterministic preflight run 37100258483 failed at active-project overlap because .gitignore was not emitted. The worker itself completed; the generated audit script omitted hidden/dot files from candidate-root enumeration.
orchestrator_corrections: Follow Astra Review #1 exactly and also pass the new TASK-0001 deterministic preflight in .github/workflows/worker_task.yml.
Use recommendation enum exactly: KEEP_ACTIVE, CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY, UNVERIFIED_DO_NOT_REMOVE. Do not emit CANDIDATE_FOR_AUDIT.

Load PROVENANCE_REGISTRY.jsonl into a case-insensitive HashSet of exact normalized absolute paths. For each record.file that is relative, join to ActiveProjectRoot then normalize. provenance_match=true only if candidate absolute path is in this set. No filename heuristics.
Add evidence_source enum exactly: ACTIVE_PROJECT, EXACT_PROVENANCE_MATCH, EXPLICIT_AGENT_OWNED_ROOT.

For files inside ActiveProjectRoot: recommendation=KEEP_ACTIVE, evidence_source=ACTIVE_PROJECT, provenance_match independently exact true/false. Protect .github, .gitignore, all active folders/control files, triggers, and worker_result_*.json anywhere beneath ActiveProjectRoot.

For files outside ActiveProjectRoot but under an explicit AgentOwnedCandidateRoot: exact provenance match => CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY + EXACT_PROVENANCE_MATCH; otherwise => UNVERIFIED_DO_NOT_REMOVE + EXPLICIT_AGENT_OWNED_ROOT.

Validate ActiveProjectRoot and all candidate roots are existing readable directories. Enumeration uses ErrorAction Stop and any enumeration failure causes non-zero failure; never suppress with SilentlyContinue.
Deduplicate all scanned files by normalized absolute path in a case-insensitive set/dictionary.
agent_owned_candidate_roots must always serialize as an array for zero/one/many roots.
Each item must include path, absolute_path, size_bytes, last_modified_utc, provenance_match, evidence_source, recommendation, reason. Timestamps must be UTC date-time strings.

Use true atomic output creation with FileMode.CreateNew + FileAccess.Write + FileShare.None and UTF-8 StreamWriter. Do not pre-create parent directories. Existing output path must fail without changing bytes. Default stdout creates no file.
Enforce PowerShell 7+ before unsupported APIs are used; Windows PowerShell 5.1 must fail clearly.
Schema must require all report/item fields, enum recommendation/evidence_source, and format audit_timestamp/last_modified_utc as date-time.

CURRENT_STATE must record persistent_storage_provider='Google Drive', gemini_api_key='CONFIGURED_VIA_REPOSITORY_SECRET', spend_limit_usd=0, pc_cleanup_mode='AUDIT_ONLY', and status/phase awaiting Astra review, not completed/approved.
NEXT_ACTIONS must not include 'User adds GEMINI_API_KEY' or 'User confirms the provider for the 5 TB cloud storage'.

Review packet stays PENDING_ASTRA_REVIEW. ci_evidence.status=PENDING, run_id/tested_commit/powershell_version/result all null until PR regression CI passes. Do not claim tests have passed or corrections are verified.
Review packet must list all seven candidate artifacts, planned regression workflow, PowerShell 7+ requirement, known limitations, and Astra Review #1 issues being addressed.

Provenance registry: new generated TASK-0001 files may use created_by=worker_gemini_cli/model=gemini-3.5-flash-lite. For canonical files memory/CURRENT_STATE.json and memory/NEXT_ACTIONS.json append modification events with actor/model/task; do not claim they were originally created by Gemini.
Do not delete/uninstall/stop services/write registry/kill processes/remove packages/change user files. Audit only.

Enumerate candidate roots with hidden/dot files included. In PowerShell use Get-ChildItem -Force -Recurse -File -ErrorAction Stop (or equivalent) so files such as .gitignore are present in the audit when ActiveProjectRoot is explicitly supplied as an AgentOwnedCandidateRoot.
Do not exclude dot-prefixed directories/files from active-project protection. .github and .gitignore must be emitted and classified KEEP_ACTIVE when the active project overlaps a candidate root.
Keep default invocation behavior unchanged: with AgentOwnedCandidateRoots empty, do not recursively inventory ActiveProjectRoot.
The deterministic preflight must pass the active-overlap fixtures for .gitignore, .github/workflows/manual_worker_smoke.yml, and nested-preflight/worker_result_TASK-9999.json.

blocking_issues.required_correction: Use create-new/atomic semantics with literal-path handling. Existing destinations must fail without modification; default stdout creates no file; new destination succeeds.

blocking_issues.required_correction: Always preserve JSON array shape for zero, one, and many roots.
Deduplicate using normalized absolute file paths in a case-insensitive set; summary count must equal unique item count.

Validate supplied roots exist and are directories. Missing/file-valued/unreadable roots must fail clearly or produce structured incomplete status/errors; empty readable directory must be distinguishable.
Require PowerShell 7 explicitly, enforce before unsupported APIs are used, document invocation, and make Windows PowerShell 5.1 fail immediately with a clear prerequisite message.
